$comment: Entry schema for contributes.aiContextProviders (process plugins, manifest apiVersion 2). Host validation lives in backend/plugin/contrib_ai_context_providers.go and ai_context_invoke.go. action must name one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read' and must not be aiCallable. The host calls it through plugin_host_ai_context only after the user picks the @mention in the AI composer and presses Fetch, with {provider, argument?, locale} (<= {{limits.payloadMaxBytes}} bytes, argument a single line <= {{limits.argumentMaxRunes}} characters, timeout {{limits.timeoutMs}} ms), and expects {"text": string, "title"?: string, "truncated"?: boolean} (<= {{limits.resultMaxBytes}} bytes, valid UTF-8 without NUL; hidden, control and bidirectional characters are removed, text beyond {{limits.resultMaxChars}} characters is cut, title <= {{limits.resultTitleMaxRunes}} characters). The text is previewed read-only and becomes a labelled, untrusted attachment only when the user inserts it. Mentions must not be one of the host's reserved mentions ({{lists.reservedMentions}}) and must be unique within the plugin.
description: AI context providers: let the user attach text fetched by one of this plugin's read actions to an AI message through an @mention.

mention.description: What the user types after @ (2-24 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens).

action.description: Id of one of this plugin's contributes.actions with risk 'read' and without aiCallable.

argument.description: Optional single-line free-text argument the user types in the preview dialog.
